why: Company release: results for fiscal Q1 (ended 2026-08-29) come after the close on Wednesday 2026-10-07, with the call at 9:00 CT on 2026-10-08.
session_evidence: Release 'after the close of business on Wednesday, October 7, 2026', so amc, and the reaction is in the 2026-10-08 session: https://finviz.com/news/397329/richardson-electronics-announces-date-of-first-quarter-fiscal-year-2027-conference-call
where_to_look: Semiconductor wafer-fab equipment capex for Aug-Sep 2026: PMT growth was wafer-fab driven, so check what Lam, Applied Materials and other OEMs said about the quarter, plus SEMI equipment billings
Green Energy Solutions: orders from wind-turbine OEMs (ultracapacitor pitch-energy modules) and the battery-energy-storage pipeline. Look for a customer named on the Q4 call or in the 10-K

Backlog trajectory: the Q4 release cited a record backlog, so look at the 10-K backlog figure and its split (https://www.rell.com/webfoo/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Q4-FY26-Press-Release-072226_HS.pdf)
Thin float (about 124k shares a day): check Forms 4 and 13F changes for who has been buying the +9% 20-day run-up
already_in_the_wire: Q4 FY26 sales rose 27.6% to $66.2m, the eighth straight quarter of growth, and the stock rose about 17-21% on 2026-07-22 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/richardson-electronics-q4-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-23/)
FY26 net sales were $228.6m with net income of $6.4m. Record backlog.
trades_on: The reported quarter's sales and backlog. Two consecutive large beats each moved it more than 21% (Q4 FY26 release https://www.rell.com/webfoo/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Q4-FY26-Press-Release-072226_HS.pdf). The company gives no formal guide.
